# Current state — lege-docwrite

## Requirements

### PageUp/PageDown move exactly one physical page or spread

`proposed` · `@docwrite.req.exact-page-navigation/1` · scope `all` · topic `navigation`

PageDown always lands on the top of the next physical page and PageUp on the previous;
in spread mode they move one spread. Continuous mouse or trackpad scrolling stays
continuous during the gesture and settles magnetically onto the nearest page (or spread)
when the gesture ends. Jumps by page number, chapter, outline entry and search result are
deterministic.

### Typing never waits on work unrelated to the edited paragraph

`proposed` · `@docwrite.req.typing-latency/1` · scope `all` · topic `typing-latency`

The hot path is key event → edit transaction → text mutation → reshape the affected
paragraph → incremental repagination to convergence → damage → present. Nothing else
runs on it: spell checking, image decoding, citation processing, index rebuilding,
search indexing, autosave serialization and export are asynchronous. For ordinary
typing in a 500-page book the application spends only a few milliseconds before handing
the frame to the presenter, and keypress-to-present latency is a regression gate.

## Observations

### Nothing in Lege-ecosystem shapes, breaks or hyphenates book text

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.no-shaping-in-workspace/3`

No ecosystem crate depends on harfbuzz/rustybuzz/harfrust/swash directly; shaping is only
reachable through cosmic-text in lege-viewer's chrome. pdf-font (skrifa 0.44) parses
TrueType, CFF, Type1 and CID programs and exposes outlines, gid_for_char and advances but
no GSUB/GPOS. There is no unicode-linebreak, unicode-segmentation, hyphenation or
Knuth-Plass code. ropey is declared in the root workspace but no Lege crate uses it.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.no-shaping-in-workspace/2`

### Lege's text extraction already supports page-anchored source passages

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.pdf-text-supports-source-passages/2`

pdf_text::TextPage exposes per-character origin, boxes and matrices, words(), rects() and
text_in_rect() over UTF-16 ranges; lege_pdf_read::positioned_words returns word boxes per
page; lege-viewer's text/selection.rs implements hit-testing and word/line/multi-page
selection. A Source Note can therefore record document, page, UTF-16 range and rectangles
and reopen the source at exactly that passage.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.pdf-text-supports-source-passages/1`

### lege-pdf-write lacks what typeset-book PDF output needs

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.pdf-write-gaps/2`

lege-pdf-write is image-oriented and append-only; DocumentWriter needs the page count up
front. It embeds Type0/Identity-H CIDFontType2 (FontFile2 only) with caller-supplied
bytes, no subsetting, no CFF/FontFile3, one glyph-font bank per page and only
None/Identity/Custom ToUnicode. Usable foundations: GlyphLine/GlyphItem TJ glyph runs,
OutlineItem bookmarks, metadata. Missing: subsetting, CFF embedding, multiple fonts per
page, per-cluster ToUnicode, path operators and RGB fill, Flate RGB/alpha images, link
annotations and named destinations, page labels, /Lang and a structure tree.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.pdf-write-gaps/1`

> **Stale** — `watches "lege-pdf/write/src/**"` was matched by `49d373bd`, which touched `lege-pdf/write/src/pages.rs`. See [REVIEW-REQUIRED.md](REVIEW-REQUIRED.md#lege-pdf-write-lacks-what-typeset-book-pdf-output-needs).

### pixelkit-shell needs presenter injection, IME, scroll phases and fuller key input

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.pixelkit-shell-gaps/2`

pixelkit-shell hardcodes SoftbufferPresenter in resumed (the Presenter trait already
exists and has a Gpu backend variant); never calls set_ime_allowed or
set_ime_cursor_area, so IME events do not arrive; drops scroll TouchPhase and
pinch/magnify; keeps only the first char of Character input, emits no key-up and maps
few function keys; FrameTimer records paint and present but not input-to-present, and
tick is recorded as zero. Rendering repaints the full frame with no damage rects. The
single-line TextFieldState has no word motion, shift-extend, clipboard or undo.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.pixelkit-shell-gaps/1`

### pixelkit-text cannot typeset books

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.pixelkit-text-limits/2`

pixelkit-text parses only TrueType glyf outlines (no CFF, variable fonts or
collections), applies a fixed feature set (GSUB ccmp/liga, GPOS kern/mark/mkmk) with no
way to request smcp/onum/etc., skips GSUB type 5/7 and GPOS types 1/3/5/7/8/9, ignores
the ScriptList, has no bidi or UAX #14 line breaking, and caches rasterized whole strings
rather than glyphs.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.pixelkit-text-limits/1`

### lege-viewer pages by line continuity and snaps only on command

`verified` · `@docwrite.observation.viewer-paging-is-line-continuity/2`

lege-viewer's PageUp/PageDown is line-continuity paging: paging_target makes the last
fully visible line the new top line, with notional-line and 8%-overlap geometric
fallbacks (lege-viewer/src/scroll/paging.rs). Nearest-page snap is an explicit command
(nearest_page_boundary, bound to S) and never happens automatically. Reusable, not
PDF-coupled: scroll/anchor.rs, frame.rs, damage.rs, diagnostics.rs, trace.rs, scene.rs,
present/*. The conductor/tile pipeline and the Pdf-variant artifact enums in
document/engine.rs assume read-only content.

**supersedes** `@docwrite.observation.viewer-paging-is-line-continuity/1`
